name: strictcode
description: A deterministic linter for architecture, with tiered auto-fixes: strictcode builds a graph of a codebase's modules, callables, and types, and enforces dependency hygiene, dead-code, cycle, and library-boundary rules across Python, Go, and TypeScript/JavaScript
